CSBC Bihar Police Driver DET Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

CSBC Bihar Police Driver DET Admit Card 2026. Candidates can now download their admit card / hall ticket from the official website before the exam date. Check important dates, application fee, eligibility criteria and official links below.

Application Fee

  • SC/ST (पुरुष/महिला) : 20 वर्ष
  • SC : 632
  • ST : 24
  • SSC Delhi Police Driver Result : CSBC Bihar Police Constable Recruitment

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.
